scope: Bilingual browser exercise that follows the same NLI example from GPT-1 to LLaMA, linked from the textbook and practice indexes.

review.example: Class softmax on (1,0,-1); two-factor text score with a tie at 0.625; the same prefix with zero, one or two demonstrations; a third factor on LLaMA. No neural model or tokenizer runs in the browser; the conditional probabilities are supplied.
review.sources: Radford et al. §§3.2–3.3, GPT-2 report §§2–3, Brown et al. §2, Touvron et al. §2.1 and Min et al. Figure 2. The already registered ACL figure was reused with its source link and license. Its emitted bytes match the audited figure in both languages.
review.verification: Local build: 2087 pages, zero broken internal links, 322 built-output checks, 94 site checks, 15 focused publisher checks and 602 source-evidence checks passed. Astro type check reported no errors or warnings. In Chromium at 375 and 1280 CSS px, both locales opened from the textbook index and handled all four stages, two-shot prompt construction, the exact tie and the LLaMA score. The calculation remains readable without JavaScript. No commit, push or deploy.
